# model.path

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.5.5</span></div>

Get the model relative path.

```lua
local name = model.path()
```

## Parameters

None.

## Returns

name (string)

## Real-world usage

<div class="api-usage">Called 2 times across 2 open-source Ethos Lua projects. A few short excerpts:</div>

=== "Example 1"

    ```lua
    local function getModelKey()
        local path = model.path and model.path() or ""
        local name = model.name and model.name() or ""
        local raw = path ~= "" and path or name
        return ofs3.utils.sanitize_filename(raw)
    end
    ```

    <small>[src/ofs3/lib/runtime.lua:82](https://github.com/robthomson/omp-ofs3-dashboard/blob/2970572ba2b0a4b47d3789f6cd29c6acdc9b231d/src/ofs3/lib/runtime.lua#L82-L87)</small>
